title: AI build plan card: draw a stage field's lifecycle (the field chip's 「借出 · 已还 ✓完成 · 逾期 ⚠」) from the plan card's new `lifecycle` key
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2926 dev report (cloud PR #3037, report `6255141756`), out-of-scope finding 2: a dependent single on cloud's producer half. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#3037

## The producer (cloud#2926, PR #3037)

cloud's plan card now carries, on a stage field's chip, `planCard.objects[].fields[].lifecycle = { options, label }`. `label` is 「借出 · 已还 ✓完成 · 逾期 ⚠」, as the AiBuild artboard draws the 状态 chip (`packages/service-ai-studio/src/build-cards.ts`; `schema/build-cards.schema.json` regenerated).

## The gap (objectui `43efd078`)

- `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:5003`, `:5048` (`PlanCardObjectRows`) draws a chip's `format.label` only.
- `ProposedPlanCard` / `liftPlanCard` (`mapMessages.ts:344`, `:500`) lift no other chip key.
- The vendored `build-cards.schema.json` lacks the key.

## Target

- The plan card's field chip draws `lifecycle.label` when it is present, beside or in place of the plain type label, as the artboard shows.
- `liftPlanCard` lifts `lifecycle`, and the vendored schema carries it.
- A chip without the key draws as today.

## Acceptance

A test: a plan-card field carrying `lifecycle` draws its label, and one without it is unchanged.
